articles.title: Much Ado About Zone 2: A Narrative Review Assessing the Efficacy of Zone 2 Training for Improving Mitochondrial Capacity and Cardiorespiratory Fitness in the General Population
articles.description: Argues the evidence does not support Zone 2 as the best intensity for mitochondrial or fat-burning gains in the general population, and that harder efforts deserve a real place in training.

articles.title: Evidence-Based Hamstring Injury Prevention and Risk Factor Management: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
articles.description: A meta-analysis of 108 randomized trials in adult athletes. Eccentric strengthening cut hamstring injury rates by roughly 57 to 70 percent.

articles.title: Monitoring Training Adaptation and Recovery Status in Athletes Using Heart Rate Variability via Mobile Devices: A Narrative Review
articles.description: A practical guide to tracking recovery with HRV from wearables and phone apps, with a focus on RMSSD and how to read day-to-day changes.
